verdict.rationale: Document chat with automatic retrieval-augmented generation is a fair question for a local LLM runner that ships a desktop chat app. Nothing in the evidence pack documents document ingestion, indexing or automatic RAG. The pack only shows local execution ('Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine') and general chat, which are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation
